text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After an outing together, Ines Fujin and I
run into
Mr. C.B. in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I saw your last scrimmage! I
couldn't believe
my eyes when you came
charging in from behind!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Really? Hehe. I'm glad you enjoyed my

performance.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to surprise the crowd like that
too. Like,
how about if... instead of
pacing myself like a
normal front runner,
I just went full pelt from start
to finish?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin chats away to Mr. C.B with a
starstruck
twinkle in her eye. Watching
the two of them, I
can't help but think...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, how could I not be?! C.B. is my upperclassman! I look up to her, and I want to show it properly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do you have time to be standing
around
talking like this? If you have any
plans or...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm just doing some shopping. I thought
it might
be nice to cook for myself more
often, so I'm here
to pick out some
quality produce.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But since I don't usually go to the
trouble, I
haven't had much luck finding
what's on my list so
far. I was just
wandering about when you bumped
into
me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's getting late, though, isn't it? Some of
the
shops will probably start closing
soon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right. Well, that's not good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind, I could help you
with that!
As your underclassman, I'd like
to offer you my
support!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I had no idea you could buy
breadcrumbs
from the butcher. And I
bought one of these
croquettes I've
heard so much about too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, look at these flowers. Apparently,
they
were planted by some local
elementary school
kids. How pretty.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, C.B.! Your croquette is
still in the
fryer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, C.B. is a bit of a... a free spirit,
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, she's gone again... C.B.?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look at these. It's a pair of retro roller
skates
from that toy store over there.
I've never seen
skates this old before.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You bought these?! You shouldn't waste
your
money like that—not when you still
have
ingredients to buy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While chasing after the free-spirited Mr.
C.B.,
Ines Fujin's nervous disposition
gradually fades
away until she's
practically back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ines, look! Roasted sweet potatoes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No sweet potatoes for you! You just had
that
croquette, didn't you? You won't
have any space
for dinner!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I'm so, so, so sorry! I can't believe I just spoke to an upperclassman like that...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Aha ha! You're a funny person,
Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine. Don't worry about it. I
don't go in
for social norms like the
whole "act proper in
front of your
upperclassmen" thing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I approach my races the same way.
Going against
the norm is how you seize
greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Roger that! Thanks for the
insight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Ines panicked for a moment
after
unwittingly acting like a big sister
to her
upperclassman, everything seems
to have turned
out all right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it looks like that behavior might
actually
be opening up new
opportunities for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Ines Fujin that Mister C.B. is right,
and it's
about time she unleashed her
real personality in
full force!
choice_data_list: 徹底的に『お姉ちゃん』をしよう！
今日はシービーと自由にやってみよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's go all out playing the "big sister"!
Let's just do things freely with C.B. today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But don't you think that'd be a
little too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me. But I think I'm going
to make
a pretty unruly little sister, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'd like one of those
potatoes please.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ack, what did I say about leaving space
for
dinner?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't just stand there, Trainer! Help me
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in front of her upperclassman, Ines
Fujin
remains entirely herself. It looks
like this was a
great learning experience
for her!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I guess we're eating out for dinner
tonight.
I'll leave the cooking for
tomorrow—wouldn't
want to pass up this
opportunity to hang out with
you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Does that actually constitute going
against social
norms?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Who knows. But it's always fun to follow
through
on your desires in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Follow through on your desires...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I know just the thing, C.B.! For dinner,
let's have
a bowl of ramen! And to top it
off...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll race you to the restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So that's what you desire right now.
Hehe, you're
on, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch the two of them dashing off
so
earnestly into the evening, I can't
help feeling
that they're actually kind of
similar.
